name: Blend Into Background
body:
School illusion (glamer); Level druid 1, ranger 1, sorcerer/wizard 1

CASTING

Casting Time 1 standard action
Components S, M (a lizard tail that is swallowed)

EFFECT

Range personal
Target you
Duration 1 hour/ level (D)

DESCRIPTION

The spell adds +1 per caster level (max +10) to any Stealth check for the duration of the spell. The spell alters the caster’s appearance, including her equipment, so that she blends into whatever background sits behind her.
